title: Derivative relations for determinants, Pfaffians and characteristic polynomials in random matrix theory
summary: Explicit expressions are proven for derivatives of the ratio of a determinant or Pfaffian determinant and a Vandermonde determinant. Such ratios appear for example in general group integrals of Harish-Chandra--Itzykson--Zuber type and in expectation values of products of characteristic polynomials in random matrix theory. In the latter case we start from known results for general non-Hermitian and Hermitian ensembles for expectation values without derivatives, at finite matrix size.
